The map is buried under fixed chrome 9/9 done

The core screen loses roughly half its pixels to an always-open legend, HUD, banners, and a legal-links footer.

MajorFixedM3Always-on legend + HUD + chrome leave roughly half the portrait map visible, with invisible tap targets under the legend

Fixed: C1: legend folded into live chips + a tap-open key sheet; ~85% of portrait is map

The map is the product, and half the screen is chrome before the user touches anything; because the legend is pointer-events:none with backdrop blur, badges and flags underneath it are silently tappable but unreadable - invisible tap targets on the app's core screen.

10-map-initial.png (legend spans ~63-280pt full-width; header ~52pt + HUD peek ~70pt + attribution + footer ~44pt leave ~45-50% unobstructed map on first load); 21-320-map.png (~26% clear map at 320px); 11a-map-hud-expanded.png (expanded sheet takes another 36vh); MapView.tsx:678-688 (six legend rows + propose hint, no collapse control); globals.css:193-209 (.map-legend always rendered, pointer-events:none, mobile rule only shrinks fonts)

MajorFixedM4Landscape phones get the desktop layout: HUD rail + legend + banner cover ~90-95% of the map

Fixed: phone map chrome now keys off pointer:coarse + height, so landscape gets it too

Rotating the phone makes the core screen effectively disappear and un-tappable.

26-landscape-map.png (812x375: 360px HUD rail, full legend, donate banner, header and footer tile the screen; only a ~33pt map strip visible bottom-right, and the HUD's last FAQ rows clip under the z-30 footer); all mobile adaptations are @media (max-width:560px) (globals.css:169, 207, 264, 462, 776, 904) which an 812px-wide landscape phone never matches, so the desktop .map-hud rail (globals.css:217-229) and .map-legend (193-201) both apply; manifest.ts:26 locks installed users to portrait but browser landscape is unguarded

MajorFixedM10Fixed banners overlay the legend, HUD, and page content on every app page, and the donate banner's only dismissal is permanent

Fixed: banners are compact strips that share the screen: below the chips on the map, above content elsewhere

An eligible user must either donate or permanently opt out of ever being asked just to read the legend, and while the banner is up it occludes whatever content sits beneath it on every page - including controls that then become untappable.

Fixed: A1: bottom tab bar (map / my games / account); legal links moved to /account

The app's core returning user - a rostered player - cannot reach their weekly game, RSVPs, or any destination from visible chrome; navigation is inverted (permanent bar for legal links, nothing for primary destinations) and content pages become multi-tap scavenger hunts in the installed app.

Dialogs are desktop modals, not sheets 8/8 done

The single thing a chat tab exists for - the input - is off-screen on short viewports (reading as read-only chat), and with the keyboard up the centered card's lower half including the composer sits behind the keyboard, so users type blind or the page jumps.

MinorFixedM25Chat auto-scroll yanks the reader to the bottom whenever the poll delivers a new message

components/ChatPanel.tsx:112-115 sets el.scrollTop = el.scrollHeight on every msgs.length change with no near-bottom check; the 7s poll (ChatPanel.tsx:14) appends messages while the panel is open

PolishFixedM55Chat timestamps freeze between polls and there is no delivery feedback for the 7s cadence

Fixed: send shows sending…, posts confirm on the immediate poll; timestamps tick at the 7s poll cadence

A message can read 'now' for many minutes, and incoming replies appear up to 7s late with no indication the panel is live, which reads as staleness rather than a deliberate tradeoff.

ago() computed at render only (components/ChatPanel.tsx:34-40); polls that return no changes set identical state so React skips re-render, leaving 'now' on screen indefinitely; POLL_MS=7000 at ChatPanel.tsx:14 (a documented Cloud Run cost tradeoff; own sends round-trip immediately via the post-send poll at :135)

Reviewing the 24 newly-captured states surfaced these - including a phone-only regression no desktop test could see.

THE BIG ONE from this pass: the phone save bar inherited top:2px from the desktop rule, so position:fixed + top + bottom stretched it into an invisible full-page tap shield - display name, change email, everything above the fold was untappable on phones. top:auto. Coverage beyond the original sweep

Every item the completeness critic named has been run down: captured and reviewed, fixed in code, superseded by the redesign, or accepted with a stated reason (2 items that are inherently device/field-data bound). Capture tooling: tests/demos/gap-captures.mts.

  • Covered Email-token landing pages (/rsvp /interested /decline /unsubscribe /verify-email) captured at 375px via tests/demos/gap-captures.mts - valid interested/unsubscribe/verify links from real emails, invalid-token states for the rest (happy paths were already e2e-covered)
  • Covered Password-reset flow captured: form, sent state, valid link, invalid token - all at phone width
  • Covered Unverified-email state end to end captured: banner over the map chips, verify link, post-verify
  • Superseded Donate money path (Stripe checkout + return) Stripe was replaced by Buy Me a Coffee (external) before the redesign - no in-app payment surface exists to audit
  • Fixed Installed-PWA launch with no network the service worker now serves an inline offline page for failed navigations - still caches nothing of the app, so no staleness story
  • Fixed Offline/slow-network beyond the map feed feed failures show the retry chip (M45); failed navigations get the offline page; tile outages degrade under still-usable chrome
  • Fixed Cellular first-load weight of the splash map-bg 2.4MB->218KB jpeg, badges 1.7MB->65KB, football ->46KB, and the gallery mounts one slide (~90KB) instead of six (~800KB)
  • Covered Form validation and server-error states captured: wrong password, duplicate email, bad zip vs the fixed save bar, reset-token errors
  • Fixed Long-press propose vs iOS text-selection/callout -webkit-touch-callout and user-select suppressed on the map surface
  • Accepted Real-device keyboard/visualViewport behavior addressed by design (interactive-widget=resizes-content, dvh caps, scrollable auth card); a physical-device pass is inherently manual - flagged for the next real-device session
  • Covered Captain states at phone width captured the captain's game page (controls, min-players, pause/retire) at 375px
  • Covered Empty and first-run states captured a sparse-area map - the HUD scenario line answers 'what now'; the no-location state was already in the original sweep
  • Covered ChangeEmail sub-flow captured the open pane at phone width
  • Covered Notification emails as mobile surfaces rendered the confirm email at 375px: single-column 540px table, system font stack, 14-15px text, 44px buttons - sound
  • Covered Error and 404 pages captured the marketing 404 and the app's missing-game state
  • Accepted In-app browser webviews (Meta, Gmail, ...) cannot be honestly emulated from here; the defensive posture is the Sentry third-party filter + dvh fallbacks - revisit if real complaint data points at a webview
  • Superseded Android back button vs modals B2 deleted the modals - game/proposed/propose are pages, so back is native navigation
  • Covered Landscape beyond the map captured the game page, account, and splash at 812x375 - scrolling pages hold up
  • Fixed Motion and vestibular accessibility global prefers-reduced-motion collapse for transitions/animations + the map's flag morph snaps into place; FlagFieldCanvas already complied
Method: production build with seeded demo data and a real login, swept by script at 375×812 (iPhone emulation), 320px, and landscape; screenshots plus source fed 12 lens-scoped reviewers; findings deduped, severity-ranked, and adversarially verified; a completeness critic named the gaps. Status chips track the feat/mobile-first rebuild; the same sweep re-runs after each phase as the before/after record. Screenshots shown are the BEFORE set. Full text: docs/design/mobile-audit.md.
